item.title: (1964) Presenting the Fabulous Ronettes Featuring Veronica
item.description: Presenting the Fabulous Ronettes Featuring Veronica is the only studio album the Ronettes made, issued by Philles in November 1964 as the fourth LP the label had ever put out.

item.title: ERAS
item.description: Long periods that music moves through. Eras are broad, overlapping spans, each defined by the sound and the conditions that prevailed while they lasted.

item.title: GENRES
item.description: Musical styles and how they branch out from one another — a timeline of where each sound began, what it grew out of, and what grew out of it.

item.title: MOMENTS
item.description: Discrete events — a concert, a broadcast, a festival — that changed the direction of music in a matter of hours or days.

item.title: ALBUMS
item.description: Full-length records, treated as complete artworks. Albums that consolidated a style, defined an artist, or extended what the format could hold.

item.title: SCENES
item.description: A scene is a coordinate: a place crossed with a moment where sounds and ways of thought coalesced. A movement is that same energy once it slips that coordinate and travels.

item.title: (1963) A Christmas Gift for You from Philles Records
item.description: Every track on this album sounds like a cathedral with a dancing congregation.

item.title: (1963) Please Please Me
item.description: Lennon’s vocal on “Twist and Shout” — recorded last, in one pass, because his voice was shredded from ten hours of singing — is raw, elated, riding the edge of physical collapse.

item.title: (1963) Presenting Dionne Warwick
item.description: Most Brill Building records in 1963 moved in 4/4 time and stayed in one key. Burt Bacharach’s songs for Dionne Warwick did neither.

item.title: (1963) The Freewheelin' Bob Dylan
item.description: On all but one of its thirteen tracks, The Freewheelin’ Bob Dylan is a young man, an acoustic guitar, and a harmonica in a neck rack, recorded mostly live to tape in a Manhattan studio across eight sessions and a single year.
